title: SessionStatus
description: Body returned by POST /sessions (202 PENDING, or 200 IN_PROGRESS on trusted auto-accept), GET /sessions/{sid} and POST /sessions/{sid}/finish. `status` is exactly one of the four TransferStatus values; causes of failure are carried in `failureReason` (a FAILED status SHOULD carry a non-null reason). `acceptedFiles` is keyed by fileId and is populated once the session is IN_PROGRESS or later. `sas` [I3] is present while a SAS comparison is pending (LSP-1 section 5.1): it carries the receiver's nonce Nr, chosen after the sender's commitment. Mirrors SessionStatus in packages/libreshare_core/lib/src/model/session_models.dart. Unknown members MUST be ignored.

sessionId.description: Random, unguessable session identifier chosen by the receiver.

failureReason.description: FailureReason when status is FAILED, otherwise null/absent. STORAGE_UNUSABLE is a sender-local classification (the receiver's download folder is unusable, see LSP-1 section on failure mapping); a receiver does not send it.

acceptedFiles.description: Map fileId -> per-file bearer token and already-received chunk ranges. Default empty.

sas.description: [I3] Present only while a SAS comparison is pending, in answer to a request that carried `sasCommit`. Absent in the plaintext profile and when no commitment was sent.

nonce.description: Nr: 16 random bytes chosen by the receiver after it received the commitment, base64url, exactly 22 characters.

token.description: 128-bit random per-file bearer token, base64url (22 chars unpadded). Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
